Primoz Roglic was wearing La Roja at the start. Ben O’Connor achieved a spectacular breakaway to win the stage and take the overall leader’s jersey. He kept it for 13 days before Roglic took it back two days before his fourth overall victory.
Today’s time trial echoes the final stage of the 1986 edition of La Vuelta, a 20-km effort in Jerez de la Frontera to conclude the race. Alvaro Pino led the overall standings with a gap of 33 seconds to Robert Millar at the start of the day, and the Spaniard won the final stage ahead of Laurent Fignon and Sean Kelly to seal his overall victory.
